tools.name: get_session_context
tools.summary: Identifies who you are acting as and which companies this connection covers.

tools.name: list_flow_block_types
tools.summary: Lists every block type the flow builder supports, with provider compatibility.

tools.name: get_flow_block_schema
tools.summary: Returns the field-level schema and constraints for one block type.

tools.name: get_flow_builder_context
tools.summary: Returns the tenant resources a flow can reference: flows, custom fields, groups, agents, approved templates and tags.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.summary: Lists the chatbot flows of the company, with node and edge counts.

tools.name: get_flow
tools.summary: Fetches a flow graph, monitoringRule, effectiveMonitoringRule and destination warnings.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.summary: Creates an empty draft flow containing only the starting block.
sideEffects: Writes a `flow.created` audit entry.

tools.name: update_flow_graph
tools.summary: Replaces the entire node and edge graph of a flow.
sideEffects: Replaces the whole graph. Nodes and edges absent from your payload are deleted.
Writes a `flow.graph.saved` audit entry.

tools.name: validate_flow_graph
tools.summary: Runs the full graph validation without persisting anything.

tools.name: update_flow_status
tools.summary: Switches a flow between draft and active.
sideEffects: An active flow starts responding to real customers immediately.
Writes a `flow.status.toggled` audit entry.

tools.name: get_stale_session_settings
tools.summary: Reads the stalled bot watchdog options for this company.

tools.name: update_stale_session_settings
tools.summary: Configures the company watchdog for contact-input sessions without a block timer.
sideEffects: Enabling it can start flows and transfer existing conversations on the next minute sweep.

tools.name: execute_flow
tools.summary: Starts an active flow for one contact right now, without waiting for a keyword.
sideEffects: The contact starts receiving the flow messages immediately.
Any flow session the contact already had is marked `superseded`.
Writes a `flow.executed` audit entry.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.summary: Lists contacts, optionally filtered by a name or phone search.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.summary: Fetches one contact by uuid, with tags and custom fields.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.summary: Lists conversations, filterable by status and by a contact search.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.summary: Fetches one conversation with contact, assignee and channel.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.summary: Returns the most recent messages of a conversation, oldest first.

tools.name: react_to_message
tools.summary: React to a message, or remove your own reaction.
sideEffects: Sends a provider reaction. A successful nonempty reaction counts as a team answer in last_message, human_reply and team_reply. Does not claim or transfer the conversation.

tools.name: send_text_message
tools.summary: Sends a free-text reply inside an existing conversation.
sideEffects: Sets the conversation status to `pending`.
Assigns the conversation to the token owner only when it has no agent; a conversation someone else holds stays with them (reassigning is a transfer, done in the dashboard).
Ends the AI agent parked on the conversation, if there is one. The flow session closes as a handoff and the bot does not come back on the next inbound message.
Writes a `conversation.reply.sent` audit entry.
When the workspace signs agent messages, the customer receives the text prefixed with the token owner's display name. The stored message and `list_messages` keep the text you sent.

tools.name: send_product_message
tools.summary: Sends buyable product card(s) from the Meta catalog in a WhatsApp conversation.
sideEffects: Sets the conversation status to `pending`.
Assigns the conversation to the token owner only when it has no agent, like `send_text_message`.
Ends the AI agent parked on the conversation, exactly like `send_text_message`.
Writes a `conversation.product.sent` audit entry.
When the workspace signs agent messages, the body goes out prefixed with the token owner's display name, like `send_text_message`.

tools.name: get_catalog_status
tools.summary: Shows the Meta catalog connection, WABA link, sync counts, and rejected products.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.summary: Lists the WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger channels connected to the company.

tools.name: set_channel_retired
tools.summary: Retires or un-retires a disconnected channel without deleting it.
sideEffects: Records the administrator and time. Retirement hides home banners and notification emails; conversations, credentials and connection state are preserved.

tools.name: list_channel_events
tools.summary: Reads channel state changes, actor, account send rejections/recovery and dropped inbound event metadata.

tools.name: get_whatsapp_config
tools.summary: Returns the current WhatsApp channel configuration.

tools.name: configure_whatsapp
tools.summary: Rewrites the WhatsApp Cloud API credentials of the company.
sideEffects: Validates against Meta and, on success, repoints the entire WhatsApp channel of the company.
Attempts a confirmation message to the actor.
Writes a `whatsapp.channel.connected` or `.updated` audit entry.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.summary: Creates a contact.
sideEffects: Writes a `contact.created` audit entry.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.summary: Updates the name, tags or custom fields of a contact.
sideEffects: Writes a `contact.updated` audit entry.

tools.name: block_contact
tools.summary: Blocks a contact in both directions.
sideEffects: Inbound messages and calls from the contact are dropped: no conversation, bot or notification.
Closes the open conversation and stops its bot, without the close-CRM policy.
Every send to the contact is refused with `contact_blocked`: replies, flows, templates and campaigns.
On WhatsApp also calls Meta `block_users`; writes a `contact.blocked` audit entry.

tools.name: unblock_contact
tools.summary: Removes the block from a contact.
sideEffects: Writes a `contact.unblocked` audit entry. Does not reopen any conversation.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.summary: Lists the tag definitions of the company.

tools.name: create_tag
tools.summary: Creates a tag definition in the company.
sideEffects: Writes a `tag.created` audit entry.

tools.name: list_custom_field_definitions
tools.summary: Lists the custom field definitions, with key, type and whether they are required.

tools.name: update_conversation_fields
tools.summary: Updates custom field values in a visible conversation.

tools.name: update_conversation_status
tools.summary: Moves a conversation between open, pending and resolved.
sideEffects: Writes a conversation audit entry naming the new status.
With `crmStageUuid`, also moves (or creates) the contact CRM opportunity and writes a `crm.opportunity.moved`/`.created` entry.

tools.name: assign_conversation
tools.summary: Assigns a conversation to an agent, a group, or neither.
sideEffects: Writes a `conversation.assigned` audit entry.

tools.name: get_group_distribution_report
tools.summary: Read daily group receipts, presence and distribution queue waits.

tools.name: get_group
tools.summary: Read group configuration and membership.

tools.name: create_group
tools.summary: Create a support group and its CRM pipeline.
sideEffects: Creates the group and CRM pipeline, saves membership and audits the change. Membership affects access and conversation distribution.

tools.name: update_group
tools.summary: Patch a support group, its settings and its membership.
sideEffects: Saves and audits group settings and membership. Removed members lose CRM assignments within this group.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.summary: Read a human agent and their company-local access profile and groups.

tools.name: get_team_configuration_context
tools.summary: Discover access profiles and pending invitations in the current company.

tools.name: invite_agent
tools.summary: Send an invitation email to a human attendant.
sideEffects: Creates or renews an invitation and queues its email. The access profile always replaces the pending one; omitted groups preserve a pending invitation and empty groups clear them.

tools.name: update_agent
tools.summary: Patch a human agent and their local access profile.
sideEffects: Saves and audits supplied details and the company-local access profile. Profile changes affect access to company data.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.summary: Lists the support groups of the company.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.summary: Lists the users of the company with the uuids used for assignment.

tools.name: list_whatsapp_templates
tools.summary: Lists Meta message templates, defaulting to the approved ones.

tools.name: create_whatsapp_template
tools.summary: Submits a new message template to Meta for review.
sideEffects: Sends the template to Meta. Submissions are visible to Meta review and count against the account.
Writes a `whatsapp.template.created` audit entry.

tools.name: send_template_message
tools.summary: Sends an approved Meta template, opening the conversation if needed.
sideEffects: Assigns the conversation to the token owner only when it has no agent.
Creates the contact and the conversation when addressed by `phone` and they do not exist.
Writes a `conversation.template.sent` audit entry.

tools.name: list_crm_groups
tools.summary: Lists the groups whose CRM pipelines the actor can access.

tools.name: get_crm_board
tools.summary: Returns the full Kanban board of a group: stages and their opportunities.

tools.name: get_crm_metrics
tools.summary: Returns aggregated pipeline numbers: open value, overdue, won this month.

tools.name: list_crm_opportunities
tools.summary: Lists opportunities in a pipeline, filterable by stage, assignee, due state, text and external id.

tools.name: get_crm_opportunity
tools.summary: Fetches one opportunity by uuid.

tools.name: create_crm_opportunity
tools.summary: Creates an opportunity in a pipeline stage.
sideEffects: Writes a `crm.opportunity.created` audit entry.

tools.name: move_crm_opportunity
tools.summary: Moves an opportunity to another stage, including the terminal won and lost stages.
sideEffects: Writes a `crm.opportunity.moved` or `.closed` audit entry.

tools.name: get_storefront_summary
tools.summary: Returns the storefront configuration, links, categories, shipping options and products.

tools.name: list_store_coupons
tools.summary: Lists company coupons with current rules and versions.

tools.name: save_store_coupon
tools.summary: Creates, updates, pauses or archives a coupon.

tools.name: get_store_discount_policy
tools.summary: Reads an AI agent discount policy.

tools.name: save_store_discount_policy
tools.summary: Configures an agent discount range and eligibility.

tools.name: list_store_products
tools.summary: Lists products, filterable by category, active state, text and externalId.

tools.name: get_store_product
tools.summary: Fetches one product with its variants.

tools.name: list_store_orders
tools.summary: Lists store orders, filterable by status.

tools.name: get_store_order
tools.summary: Fetches one order with its item snapshot.

tools.name: get_store_metrics
tools.summary: Returns sales metrics for a period.

tools.name: update_store_order_status
tools.summary: Advances an order along its status machine.

tools.name: create_store_product
tools.summary: Creates a product, optionally with variants.

tools.name: update_store_product
tools.summary: Updates a product; omitted fields keep their value.
sideEffects: When `variants` is sent, variants missing from it are deleted.

tools.name: list_ai_agents
tools.summary: List AI agents

tools.name: get_ai_agent_usage
tools.summary: Get AI agent usage and cost

tools.name: get_ai_agent
tools.summary: Get AI agent

tools.name: get_ai_agent_configuration_context
tools.summary: Get AI agent configuration context

tools.name: create_ai_agent
tools.summary: Create AI agent
sideEffects: Configuration is saved and audited. Active agents read updates live. Activation, default attendance and deletion remain in the dashboard.

tools.name: test_ai_agent
tools.summary: Test AI agent
sideEffects: Calls company BYOK and consumes budget. Records cost and metadata-only audit; 10 tests/minute per company (or lower plan cap), fail closed if limiter is unavailable. No conversation, message, CRM, field, cart, order, payment or notification is created.

tools.name: update_ai_agent
tools.summary: Update AI agent
sideEffects: Configuration is saved and audited. Active agents read updates live. Activation, default attendance and deletion remain in the dashboard.

tools.name: list_knowledge_sources
tools.summary: Lists the AI agent's knowledge base sources with indexing status, plan usage and limits.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.summary: Runs the same hybrid search the AI agent uses and returns the matching excerpts.

tools.name: create_knowledge_source
tools.summary: Adds a text, FAQ or public URL source to the AI agent knowledge base.
sideEffects: Goes live once indexed: every active AI agent without explicitly linked sources answers customers from ALL sources. The response lists them in `usedByAgents`.
A `url` source is fetched by the server in the background; only public http(s) addresses are accepted.

tools.name: update_knowledge_source
tools.summary: Updates URL authentication and refresh configuration.
sideEffects: Changing authentication or enabling refresh queues a reread for ready/failed sources. Active agents may use the updated content.

tools.name: reindex_knowledge_source
tools.summary: Queues a forced reread of one URL source.
sideEffects: Fetches the URL and can spend embeddings, even when the document has not changed.

tools.name: list_keywords
tools.summary: Lists the keyword triggers and the default flow of each kind.

tools.name: create_keyword
tools.summary: Makes a flow start when an inbound message matches a keyword.
sideEffects: Goes live immediately for every inbound message of the company.

tools.name: delete_keyword
tools.summary: Removes a keyword trigger; the flow stays as it is.

tools.name: set_default_flow
tools.summary: Chooses the flow for first contact, for unmatched messages or for storefront orders.
sideEffects: Replaces the flow that held the slot before.

tools.name: get_flow_errors
tools.summary: Lists a flow's errors from the last 7 days, block by block.

tools.name: create_conversation_note
tools.summary: Adds an internal note to a conversation, visible only to the team.
sideEffects: Mentioned users are notified.

tools.name: set_conversation_tags
tools.summary: Adds or removes tags on the conversation itself.

tools.name: list_markers
tools.summary: Lists the authenticated user's personal markers.

tools.name: set_conversation_markers
tools.summary: Applies or removes your personal markers on a conversation.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.summary: Lists your pending reminders on a conversation.

tools.name: create_reminder
tools.summary: Reminds you to get back to a conversation at a given time.
sideEffects: The reminder notifies the authenticated user in the dashboard at that time.

tools.name: complete_reminder
tools.summary: Marks one of your reminders as done.

tools.name: update_crm_opportunity
tools.summary: Edits an opportunity: title, value, due date, notes, contact, assignee or external id.
sideEffects: Writes a `crm.opportunity.updated` audit entry.

tools.name: sync_whatsapp_templates
tools.summary: Pulls the status and content of every template from Meta.
sideEffects: A template deleted in the WhatsApp Manager is removed here too, so it can no longer be sent.

tools.name: update_tag
tools.summary: Renames, recolors or archives a tag.
sideEffects: Renaming rewrites the name on every contact and conversation that carries it.
Flows that reference the old name are not rewritten; the result says how many (`flowsStillUsingOldName`) — tell the user.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.summary: Deletes a tag and removes its name from every contact and conversation.
sideEffects: Irreversible: the name disappears from contacts and conversations.

tools.name: recalculate_team_reply
tools.summary: Preview or recalculate waiting-for-team markers, one company page at a time.

tools.name: get_ownerless_fallback
tools.summary: Read ownerless fallback destinations and warnings.

tools.name: update_ownerless_fallback
tools.summary: Configure automatic group routing for ownerless conversations.
sideEffects: After any flow termination or completed inbound routing, eligible conversations enter the normal group queue/distribution with an internal note and system webhooks. No outbound message is sent.

tools.name: apply_ownerless_fallback
tools.summary: Preview or explicitly apply fallback to current ownerless stock.
sideEffects: dryRun=false assigns eligible conversations with one internal system note through normal distribution, including balanced_daily; no message goes to the person.

tools.name: get_inbox_response_settings
tools.summary: Read the company unanswered and overdue clock mode.

tools.name: update_inbox_response_settings
tools.summary: Opt the company into human-reply unanswered views, or restore last-message behavior.

tools.name: get_conversation_panel
tools.summary: Read company cards, native placements, visibility options and warnings.

tools.name: update_conversation_panel
tools.summary: Configure card titles, Hugeicons, ordering and native placements.
sideEffects: transferTargets (all/members, default all) limits only the panel transfer menu and unitary assignment to actual group members, including member-supervisors; bulk assignment and automatic distribution stay unchanged. phoneEquivalenceBrNinthDigit (false) enables same-company Brazilian mobile lookup with/without the ninth digit without modifying existing contacts or send destinations. Split pairs select the most recent conversation and are logged; Public API contact resolution and blocking are unchanged. Patches panel options; supplied cards/nativeItems/fieldItems arrays replace their lists, omitted arrays and item attributes are preserved. topCards (false) requires detailsReadOnly. detailsCrmStage (show/hide) affects only Details. wrapValues (false) wraps long values. nativeItems accepts width (full/half) and hideWhenEmpty (false); fieldItems accepts fieldUuid, width and placement (body/header). Consecutive half fields pair at card width >=340px, with one column on narrow/mobile. Header links keep HTTPS validation and hide from the body. Does not grant field editing to access profiles.

tools.name: create_custom_field
tools.summary: Creates a custom field for contacts or conversations.

tools.name: update_custom_field
tools.summary: Changes label, type, scope or flags of a custom field.

tools.name: delete_custom_field
tools.summary: Deletes a custom field definition; stored values stay on the records.

tools.name: list_business_schedules
tools.summary: Lists the business schedules with weekly hours, exceptions and whether each is open now.

tools.name: create_business_schedule
tools.summary: Creates a named business schedule.

tools.name: update_business_schedule
tools.summary: Replaces the hours of a business schedule.
sideEffects: Every flow and group using the schedule follows the new hours immediately.

tools.name: create_crm_stage
tools.summary: Adds an open stage to a group pipeline.

tools.name: update_crm_stage
tools.summary: Renames, recolors or sets the external id of a CRM stage.

tools.name: reorder_crm_stages
tools.summary: Sets the order of all stages of a group pipeline.

tools.name: delete_crm_stage
tools.summary: Deletes an open CRM stage, moving its opportunities to a replacement.

tools.name: create_store_category
tools.summary: Creates a storefront category.

tools.name: update_store_category
tools.summary: Renames or repositions a storefront category.

tools.name: delete_store_category
tools.summary: Deletes a storefront category; its products stay, without a category.

tools.name: update_flow
tools.summary: Renames a flow or changes channels, entries and its monitoringRule.

tools.name: delete_flow
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a flow and its graph.
sideEffects: Irreversible. Keyword triggers and default slots that pointed to the flow stop working.

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a contact, with its conversations and CRM opportunities.
sideEffects: Irreversible. Conversations and CRM opportunities of the contact go with it.

tools.name: delete_store_product
tools.summary: Permanently deletes a storefront product and its images.

tools.name: archive_crm_opportunity
tools.summary: Archives an opportunity, removing it from the board.

tools.name: delete_whatsapp_template
tools.summary: Deletes a WhatsApp template at Meta and here.
sideEffects: Irreversible at Meta. Campaigns, flows and quick sends that use it stop working.
Meta does not let the same name be reused for about 30 days.

tools.name: delete_knowledge_source
tools.summary: Deletes a knowledge base source; AI agents stop answering from it.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.summary: Deletes a team group and its CRM pipeline.
sideEffects: Opportunities of the group CRM are removed; conversations assigned to the group lose the group.

tools.name: send_media_message
tools.summary: Sends a file from the company file library in a conversation.
sideEffects: The customer receives it immediately; it cannot be recalled.
Same conversation effects as send_text_message: status → pending, claimed only when unassigned.

tools.name: create_store_order
tools.summary: Registers an order for a customer, like the manual order in the dashboard.
sideEffects: Reserves stock and runs the store automation, which messages the buyer.
Prices always come from the catalog; they cannot be overridden.

tools.name: get_ai_summary_settings
tools.summary: Read automatic internal summary settings.

tools.name: get_ai_summary_costs
tools.summary: Read daily costs and per-call usage for automatic summaries.

tools.name: update_ai_summary_settings
tools.summary: Configure automatic internal conversation summaries.
sideEffects: Enabling permits paid model calls, internal notes and conversation.ai_summary webhooks on future activity. No customer message is sent.

tools.name: get_entry_settings
tools.summary: Read whether the company separates public and private entries.

tools.name: update_entry_settings
tools.summary: Configure company entrySplit.
sideEffects: public_private routes comment and mention to public conversations and the remaining entries to private conversations. Existing history is never backfilled or moved.
